title: Distributional Deep Hedging
abstract: arXiv:2611.26652v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep hedging learns a hedging strategy by optimising a risk preference over a neural-network policy. The preference is fixed before training, so each new preference requires a new policy and, in actor-critic methods, a new critic. We propose distributional deep hedging, in which the distribution of the hedging profit and loss is learned through its quantiles and the risk preference is applied afterwards, as a weight on those quantiles. We characterise the preferences that admit this representation, which include expected shortfall and its mixtures, and show that the entropic utility is computed from the same quantiles. At the current policy, each of these preferences is bounded below by an expected utility with the same gradient. This bound reduces risk-sensitive hedging to a sequence of risk-neutral problems, from which we derive policy-search and actor-critic algorithms. translated_abstract: 深度对冲通过在神经网络策略上优化风险偏好来学习对冲策略。风险偏好在训练之前是固定的，因此每个新的偏好都需要一个新的策略，并且在actor-critic方法中还需要一个新的critic（评论家网络）。我们提出了分布式深度对冲，该方法通过对冲损益分布的分位数来学习损益分布，并在训练之后应用风险偏好，将其作为这些分位数的权重。我们刻画了允许这种表示的风险偏好，包括预期损失及其混合形式，并证明熵效用可以从相同的分位数计算得出。在当前策略下，这些偏好中的每一个都有一个下界，该下界是具有相同梯度的期望效用。这一界将风险敏感对冲问题转化为一系列风险中性问题，由此我们推导出了策略搜索和actor-critic算法。在数值实验中，学习到的对冲策略接近参考（原文摘要似乎在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出分布式深度对冲方法，通过学习对冲损益分布的分位数，使风险偏好可在训练后作为权重灵活应用，从而将风险敏感对冲问题简化为一系列风险中性问题，避免了为每个新风险偏好重新训练策略的需求。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes distributional deep hedging, which learns the hedging P&L distribution through its quantiles so that risk preferences can be applied afterwards as weights, reducing risk-sensitive hedging to a sequence of risk-neutral problems and eliminating the need to retrain policies for each new preference.
